findings.title: Name sanitizer leaves bidi and format characters
findings.problem: _NAME_UNSAFE only matches \x00-\x1f, \x7f and < > ' " & `. C1 controls (\x80-\x9f, except \x85 which str.split already collapses), zero-width characters (U+200B-U+200F, U+FEFF) and bidi overrides (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) pass through _clean_name into the user-facing message. The spec requires control characters removed from names in messages; the test_server_name_is_cleaned cases cover only C0 characters. Separately, [:60] is applied after the whitespace join, so a cut-off name can end in a trailing space inside the quotes.
findings.impact: A crafted server name (user-supplied in the save payload; reachable via assistant, workflow and skill saves) can reorder or spoof text in the toast shown to the user. Reachability confirmed: _labels feeds every new restricted-mode, restore and catalogue refusal message.
findings.recommendation: Extend the character class to cover \x80-\x9f, \u200b-\u200f, \u2028-\u2029, \u202a-\u202e, \u2066-\u2069 and \ufeff, strip the result after the 60-character cut, and add cases for these characters to test_server_name_is_cleaned.

findings.title: Restore of overridden catalogue server is untested
findings.problem: validate_on_restore now builds blocked = custom + overridden from _restricted_violations. TestValidateOnRestore and the version-service rollback test only use a command-only server with no mcp_config_id, which lands in the custom branch. No test restores a catalogue server with use_custom_config=True or inline connection fields.
findings.impact: If the overridden list were dropped from the restore check, a rollback to a version holding a catalogue server with a custom configuration would silently succeed in restricted mode, bypassing the administrator policy, and every existing test would still pass. validate_on_restore has a single caller, assistant_version_service.py:264.
findings.recommendation: Add restricted-mode tests in TestValidateOnRestore for _server('cat', mcp_config_id='cfg-1', use_custom_config=True) and _server('cat', mcp_config_id='cfg-1', command='uvx'), each expecting a ValidationException matching "Can't restore this version" and naming 'cat'.
